t: What he said about a hundred conditions
a: مَا بَالُ أَقْوَامٍ يَشْتَرِطُونَ شُرُوطًا لَيْسَتْ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ، مَنِ اشْتَرَطَ شَرْطًا لَيْسَ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ فَلَيْسَ لَهُ، وَإِنِ اشْتَرَطَ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ
p: Mā bālu aqwāmin yashtariṭūna shurūṭan laysat fī kitābi-Llāh. Mani-shtaraṭa sharṭan laysa fī kitābi-Llāhi fa-laysa lah, wa ini-shtaraṭa miʾata marrah
m: What is the matter with people who stipulate conditions that are not in the Book of Allah? Whoever stipulates a condition that is not in the Book of Allah does not have it, even if he stipulates it a hundred times.
